[EN] I won't come until you call me.
[ES] No vendré hasta que me llames.

[EN] Tell me: How did you defeat Vergos?
[ES] Dime: ¿Cómo derrotaste a Vergos?

[EN] I can take care of you whenever I want. But I'm busy right now...
[ES] Puedo encargarme de ti cuando quiera. Pero ahora estoy ocupado...
